lead.t: Treatment is supportive, because infection is self-limited and anthelmintic drugs do not appear to influence the outcome of infection.

snip.t: Treatment is supportive, because infection is self-limited and anthelmintic drugs do not appear to influence the outcome of infection.
Important: In cases of severe anemia, treat anemia before administering anthelmintic drugs to avoid complications.

qs.q: An intensely heavy hookworm infection causes severe chronic anemia in a patient. What is a critical management rule before administering anthelmintic therapy in this scenario?
qs.e: In cases of severe anemia, it is vital to treat the anemia first with iron supplements or blood transfusions before giving anthelmintic drugs to prevent fatal complications. Anthelmintics alone do not immediately reverse the critical hemodynamic instability of severe anemia.
